item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! It's Monday, October 5. Time for the weather! A fresh new week begins today. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be rather grey and cloudy. The warmest part of the day will be 22 degrees, and the coolest 17. Comfortable enough to forget about the weather altogether. The chance of rain is 12 percent. Did you know today is day 278 of the year? There are 87 days to go until the new one. Grey skies are still good for the park. Bring your ball! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be sunny from start to finish, with a high of 22 degrees. This week our theme is teachers. Think about something one of them taught you. And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
